title: Assignment 06 · Assent and intention to be legally bound
summary: Assent and intention to be legally bound. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Lucy v. Zehmer: The sellers’ words and conduct reasonably conveyed a serious land sale, so an undisclosed intention to joke did not defeat enforcement.

Balfour v. Balfour: A husband’s promise of a temporary living allowance while the spouses remained amicably married did not establish the contractual obligation the wife sought to enforce.

Specht v. Netscape Communications Corp.: Downloading free software did not manifest assent to license terms hidden below the download button without reasonably conspicuous notice.

Additional assigned materials: Restatement of Consumer Contracts § 2(a), (c).
